text:
Alex Kim: hi all, first day! quick blockers: can't open the "Redwood Design System" Figma file (403). also couldn't find the up-to-date roadmap - found two different notion pages. small items but would love pointers so i can start pairing this week
Riley Gomez: welcome Alex!! Figma email? i'll add you. canonical roadmap is Notion > Product Workspace > Roadmaps > Live (we enforce this).
Alex Kim: alex.kim@redwood.ai thanks Riley
welcome-bot: Welcome Alex! New hire checklist: 1) Request Figma access 2) Join #product-sync + #design-ops 3) Read "Product Roadmap (Live)" 4) Review Research Playbook. Link: https://notion.redwood.ai/s/onboarding-product
Tara Singh: added you to the Design org and invited to the shared file. if you still see 403, try logging out/in or accept invite from email. i'll drop the Figma file link in a sec.
Ben Cho: hey Alex 44b re roadmap: we keep one canonical page and a weekly snapshot. if you see divergences ping me and i can reconcile. also PRDs live under the "In Review" section.
Alex Kim: got the invite, can open now 389 thanks Tara. also want to ramp on research - is there a short playbook and a list of recent studies i can read? any chance to shadow a session this week?
Tara Singh: research playbook: Product > Research Playbook in Notion. it has templates (discussion guide, consent, analysis notes). recruiting is via design-ops, triage on Thursdays. i'll add you to the next interview as an observer.
Riley Gomez: fyi we publish concise research summaries to #product and tag squads. for full transcripts see Notion research pages. if you want to run a quick usability test, use Maze; request a seat via the design-ops form.
Alex Kim: great. last Q: design tokens workflow? i'd like to avoid breaking changes when editing the shared library
Ben Cho: tokens are maintained in the design system Figma + the tokens Notion doc. small cosmetic tweaks ok in a feature branch but any token publish to prod must go through the platform review (tag @ben and @platform in your PR). follow the token checklist: update changelog, run visual-diff, ship migration notes.
Tara Singh: we also do 15m token reviews on Fridays for anything touching tokens. ping me if you're making changes and i'll slot you.
Alex Kim: perfect, thanks everyone. who do I ask for Maze / Lookback seats and access to the research calendar?
Tara Singh: Maze seats -> design-ops (i'll DM the request form). Lookback access -> research-ops; request link in the playbook. calendar is shared as "Research Sessions" in GCal, i'll invite you.
Alex Kim: awesome, appreciate the fast help. excited to join the pairing session tomorrow morning :)
Riley Gomez: welcome aboard Alex 680 we'll assign a buddy and add you to the Tuesday design pairing. ping any time if something else is blocked
Alex Kim: thanks team! i'll follow the checklist and start reading the roadmap + research notes tonight
